subject: Invoice & billing ops requirements — Acme Corp procurement readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice & billing ops requirements — Acme Corp procurement readiness

Hi Sofia / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the time on today's demo — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Per our conversation, wanted to summarize next steps and clarify billing/procurement requirements so we can get the commercial paperwork in motion: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned preference for PO + Net-30 for production. Can you confirm if that will be via a standard PO or a marketplace (AWS/Azure) purchase?
- Invoice requirements: please confirm billing address, whether you need line-item invoices, CSV vs PDF format, and your preferred invoicing frequency (monthly/quarterly).
- Tax/VAT: please confirm whether Acme is subject to VAT (I think US only, but want to be sure for any EU entities). Also send the tax ID or W-9 contact.
- PO template: if you have a PO template, please attach. If you prefer a charge card for an initial pilot, we can also accept that, but want to note differences in onboarding timeline.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-v1.pdf (draft SOW we discussed).

Proposed next steps:
1) If PO path: share Acme PO template and billing contact + desired Net terms.
2) We (Redwood) will send over W-9, sample invoice, and a DocuSign SOW if legal is ready.
3) Ben (billing ops) and Monica (CS) will be looped to finalize invoice format and marketplace questions.

Happy to hop on a 15–20 minute call if that's faster — otherwise we can proceed over email.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Invoice & billing ops requirements — Acme Corp procurement readiness

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — short answers below from procurement side: 

- Procurement path: We prefer PO with Net-30 for production. For pilots, we sometimes use corporate card, but long-term this will be PO. We are not planning to buy through marketplace today (we may revisit later).
- Billing address / remit to:
  Acme Corp
  Accounts Payable
  100 Market Street, 12th Floor
  San Francisco, CA 94105
- Invoice format: PDF is fine; we require line items that map to the subscription SKU and unit quantities. A CSV export option is a plus but not required.
- Tax/VAT: US entity — no VAT. Our US tax ID is 12-3456789; procurement requires a vendor W-9 on file.
- PO template: attaching our PO template (Acme_PO_Template.pdf). Please fill vendor fields and return.

Proc timeline: We have a standard legal review + procurement signoff. Expect 7–10 business days after we receive a completed PO and W-9. Legal may request minor SOW redlines.

Attaching: Acme_PO_Template.pdf

Sofia Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
sofia.martinez@acme-corp.com

Hi Sofia — great, this is helpful, thanks. A couple quick items and confirms from our side: 

- Net-30 PO path is fine. We'll populate your PO template and return with vendor details.
- We'll send over our W-9 and a sample invoice that matches your requested line-item format. Attaching now: Redwood_W9.pdf, Invoice_Sample_Standard.pdf.
- DocuSign: I've created a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link below) so legal can review redlines inline. If legal prefers a marked-up PDF, we can provide that instead.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: fill in Acme_PO_Template and return (I will attach filled copy once complete).

Marissa / Monica,

I'll take point on the billing ops and marketplace question. Quick notes: 
- AWS Marketplace listing can speed procurement for some customers but adds ~2 weeks for seller onboarding and tax/VAT validation; not ideal if Acme wants a ~7–10 business day turnaround.
- I'll prepare a vendor packet (filled PO, W-9, sample invoice) and send to Sofia's AP inbox as soon as Marissa returns the completed PO.
- For invoicing: we'll include a line for subscription SKU, quantity, term, and an invoice reference field for Acme PO#. If they later need CSV export, we can provide the file on request.

I'll draft the filled PO and send it by EOD tomorrow.

Ben Carter
